study.question: Can context condition the saturation of projected compressed blocks, rather than only reweight their already saturated summary, improving click AUC at unchanged learned capacity and justified measured cost?
study.hypothesis: The incumbent discards context-dependent distinctions by applying tanh to projected blocks before context gating. Moving the same bounded task-specific query inside tanh may preserve useful block amplitudes through context-dependent saturation. Near zero both branches have first-order q*z, but they differ for saturated block coordinates. Auxiliary context transfer may interact with that placement; the complete 2x2 separates its local effect. This is unverified.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary text lines250..277 motivates candidate-conditioned unnormalized activation. Retain the inherited adapted DIN base; change a downstream task/context-conditioned block branch, not the original attention unit. No exact reproduction or priority claim.

Pinned benchmark lines276..343 use sequence self-attention/FFN then global-query cross-attention. Here fixed compressed blocks and existing rank16 task matrices remain; query gates coordinates inside tanh without Q/K/V attention or a sequence stack. Original-author equivalence not established.

Pinned benchmark lines187..282 alternate query mixing, sequence FFN, cross-attention and output fusion. This proposal isolates context-dependent nonlinear encoding on fixed block contributions without evolving query tokens or cross-attention. No transfer claim.
Pinned lines113..159 pool target history then tokenize field/task features. Here no tokenizer/interaction stack is introduced; all existing task matrices are retained.

inherited_components: All learned components, initialization and frozen source boundaries from candidate.py / g0-r0052-block_nonlinear_transfer
Folded weighted Dice support, independent auxiliary running buffers and pruned evaluation
Signed uniform click base, feedback auxiliary base, five masked target-match/order detail channels and task residual adapters
Per-task rank16 context queries/history projections/zero-initialized output matrices and final RMS normalization
study.proposed_difference: Replace q * mean_valid(tanh(z_j)) by mean_valid(tanh(q * z_j)), where q=tanh(Q_t c) and z_j=P_t[M*b_j, counts, five global details]. No added learned parameters, features or loss change. Cross this single ordering change with the existing auxiliary adapter-context gradient gate; execute both paths in all cells. Work-matched diagnostic, not an optimized deployment.
predictions: inside_transfer should exceed outside_transfer_bridge and both frozen source bests on full validation click AUC if this implementation is useful; magnitude is unknown.

The inside/outside contrast should persist in a repetition before repeated support; a difference in differences would indicate dependence on auxiliary context transfer, not establish the full causal pathway.
At common weights, q=0 gives zero in both paths; q=+1 or-1 yields equal values; the small-logit first-order limit agrees, while intermediate query magnitude and saturated logits differ.
Empty support gives exactly zero block fusion; permuting valid blocks with global details held fixed preserves output; invalid blocks cannot affect the summary.
Learned counts should remain32192421 total,31793216 embedding,399205 dense, subject to host verification; performance/runtime for new cells is unmeasured.
falsifiers: No positive click-AUC difference from the work-matched outside bridge leaves useful ordering unsupported for this implementation.
Equal/worse quality at higher measured cost rejects an efficiency improvement; unexpected parameter/input/protocol changes invalidate the intended comparison.
Broken masking, nonfinite native gradients, incorrect auxiliary gradient edges or nonzero bridge mismatch invalidates mechanism interpretation and must be recorded as an execution/integrity failure.
If a later context-independent desaturation control matches any gain, context-specific preservation is not established; capacity equality alone does not rule out generic desaturation.
alternative_explanations: One training seed, adaptive selection over many validation comparisons and no new user-cluster uncertainty
Inside placement changes saturation, Jacobians, effective scale and optimization together; these are not separately attributed
Common computation graphs do not guarantee identical hardware cost; report actual costs
Coordinate gating has no learned block selection and cannot recover information already removed by fixed compression
Uniform reduction of saturation rather than useful context specificity
Changes to RMS-normalized direction or regularization and sparse gradient accumulation, rather than recovery of lost behavioral distinctions
Delayed feedback visibility and whole-window vocab/static snapshots restrict any finding to the released offline benchmark
